versions.content: Function Inhibition Manager Use Case: Software- component wants to get notified when FID state changes Scenario: Scenario: a software-component wants a notification when the status of a given FID permission state changes. The notification is delivered as a call to a callback implemented by the software- component. Therefore, the software-component has to define a PPortPrototype for this purpose.
